incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=synthetics-auth-eu-west check=synth-auth-1 severity=critical :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident <https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345|PD12345> — Multiple synth check failures (auth 401 spike). Escalating to SRE on-call.
raj: acked. Im taking primary. Looking at dashboards now.
emma: seeing the same. EU-west canary auth check has ~80% 401s for the last 3m. Request rate stable. Probably auth upstream?
mike: telemetry shows a sudden increase in 401s only on the synthetic user-agent. Real traffic for login endpoints is normal. Dumping sample log lines:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z synth-auth-1 200 GET /health - latency=12ms
2026-03-15T09:12:38Z synth-auth-1 401 POST /api/v1/login user=synth-client token=NA err=invalid_token
2026-03-15T09:12:39Z synth-auth-1 401 POST /api/v1/login user=synth-client token=NA err=invalid_token
2026-03-15T09:12:41Z synth-auth-1 401 POST /api/v1/login user=synth-client token=NA err=invalid_token
```
olivia: adding context — we rolled a minor auth-service config change in eu-west ~08:50 UTC, but global rollout targeted. Change was a handshake timeout tweak.
jack_oncall: can we confirm whether the change affects service principal tokens used by synth?
emma: good call. mike, can you query token introspection logs for the synth client id?
mike: running quick query: `logs | where client_id=="synth-client" and status==401 | count()` -> 340 in last 5m. Token validation service returning 401 with body `{\"error\":\"invalid_assertion\"}`.
raj: ok likely the config tweak tightened JWT issuer validation. Two mitigation paths: 1) pause synth-runner to stop noisy paging, 2) rollback auth-config in eu-west if confirmed.
sara: copying PD incident to eng-runtime and auth-team. @olivia can you confirm if rollback is safe? If not, we pause synth.
olivia: rollback is safe but needs a 2-step deploy window ~5 min. I can do immediate rollback.
emma: let's pause the probe first to stop duplicate PD noise while rollback proceeds. Raj, can you suppress/silence alerts on PD for this check?
raj: silencing synth check on PD (60m) and adding a low-frequency backoff to synth runner. Command I'm running now:
```
redwood-cli synth pause --check synth-auth-1 --reason "auth config causing 401s" --duration 60m
```
pagerduty-bot: Silence applied to service=synthetics-auth-eu-west for 60 minutes by raj.
incident-bot: synth-runner pause acknowledged by controller. Running graceful drain of pending probes.
jack_oncall: rollback in progress. Olivia, ping when rollback deploy is complete.
olivia: rollback completed at 09:18 UTC, rolling auth config back to previous build.
mike: re-checking token introspection counts. Query result: 401s dropping. Last 5m count -> 12.
emma: prod health for login endpoints shows normal rates, latency normal, error budget unaffected.
raj: re-enable synth check with backoff (30s -> 180s) to avoid thrash. `redwood-cli synth configure --check synth-auth-1 --interval 180s`
pagerduty-bot: Silence expired early? No, silence still active. PD incident PD12345 marked acknowledged by raj.
sara: thanks team. I'm handing off to olivia for follow-up postmortem and to create a small runbook for auth-config rollbacks + synthetic backoff defaults. I'll update the PD incident notes.
olivia: will file a short follow-up: why the JWT validation change didn't include a canary exclusion and add a preflight token test for synth clients.
emma: action items:
- olivia: postmortem + rollback playbook (P0)
- mike: add alert for token-introspection 5xx/401 pattern for synth clients (P1)
- raj: review PD dedupe/suppression rules for synthetic checks (P1)
- sara: confirm backoff defaults for all synth checks (P2)

raj: closing this thread for now, PD incident PD12345 resolved/closed. If anything re-flares, please reopen. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 status: Resolved by raj.
incident-bot: Note: suppressed duplicate pages and paused synth-runner to avoid alert storm. Remember to update the runbook and add a postmortem link here when available.
